# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 GPU fixes** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 with GPU rendering corrections and an updated HarfBuzzSharp companion. Preview 2 corrects reflected hairline caps and text-atlas sampling, adds a targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround, and bounds Graphite clip recording. HarfBuzzSharp updates to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds missing named script constants.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone 158** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158 while preserving SkiaSharp's managed API surface. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU drawing correctness** — Corrects zero-length square-capped hairline scaling under reflected transforms and text-atlas sampler selection affected by interpolation imprecision. Graphite flushes when needed to bound clip recording and rejects draws whose clips cannot fit a fresh render pass. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround** — Adds a 1 ms delay on affected device-loss paths for ARM proprietary drivers from 42.0 up to, but not including, 56.0. Ordinary successful submissions are not delayed. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script fields, values, parsing and conversions are preserved.

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 adopts GPU drawing corrections and a targeted ARM Vulkan device-loss workaround. Its HarfBuzzSharp companion updates to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and adds 30 named script constants.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.158 line with Skia m158 and no SkiaSharp managed API changes. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 without changing its HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.1.26560.6...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
